classification: Author scoped content and two-reader-path review; no independent review or whole-manual sign-off
scope: Three existing manuals: actual planned V2 activation and reverse-fenced failback results, same exact version and topology, source and target write/read distinctions and safety boundaries. Existing DR production steps retained; no new command or diagram.
content_checks: Actual latest-source read of 12845056 bytes and SHA256 matches incremental point
Recovery 18087936-byte fsync-confirmed write is later captured in a new full backup, 26 referenced objects individually read and hashed, and actually read from the new main-site volume
Distinct native identities, original source fencing, reverse fencing and exact static claims are stated with their causal roles
Final main-site write is explicitly fsync acknowledgement, not an invented post-power-loss or cross-node readback
Workflow unfenced refusal is distinguished from native Longhorn API capability; planned software isolation is distinguished from infrastructure fencing and complete site loss
Single-node target and compressible workload limits are stated; no production RPO/RTO, HA, capacity or throughput extrapolation
Customer procedure keeps application consistency and owner-approved loss window; no test cleanup or private context substituted for production steps

reader_paths.novice: From DR task, establish independent target/store, inspect the approved actually restored point, retain source isolation, activate existing volume and follow static binding/application verification. New practice connects that sequence to observed data without replacing the production prerequisites.
reader_paths.experienced: From DR index or mechanism section, inspect exact source/target/native identities and recovery hash; follow return-to-new-volume flow and reverse isolation, use stated unknown-result stop conditions and existing recovery branches. Developer entry identifies protected native fields, current evidence gate and independent context journals.

diagram_review: No diagram changed; prior rendered diagram review reused. Existing state diagram matches observed direction of planned isolation, activation and return.
boundaries: No independent reviewer, customer approval or complete-manual claim
No extra live run for documentary wording; existing exact product results reused
